title: Urusei Yatsura
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: When alien Oni invaders challenge Earth to a game of tag, lecherous, unlucky student Ataru Moroboshi wins by snatching the alien princess Lum's bikini top. His victory cry is taken as a proposal, and Lum moves in as his self-declared wife, shocking him with electricity whenever he chases other girls. Episodic chapters bring a stream of aliens, yokai and spirits to his school and town.
life_message: Love is loyal and chaotic, and life's absurdities are best met with humor.

folkways.japan: Built on Japanese folklore (oni, tengu, yuki-onna), puns and the 'game of the Oni' tag game, with family and school sitcom norms of its era.

delivery.evidence: Critics describe sitcom gags, puns and parody with stable episodic setups; no message noted.
delivery.note: The series offers comedy rather than a thesis.

winners_losers: Lum keeps Ataru by her side; Ataru's womanizing is endlessly punished but never ends; loyal love gets the most sympathy.
